summary: The verify's own figure is confirmed at exactly 3 records -- where a word-keyed classifier reads 36 -- but selection lives in the plugin and this task holds no writable repo path, so the behaviour change is a grant away and the task is an instance of the defect it describes.

The retraction-collision case -- a grep for a retracted sentence hits the retraction that is required to quote it -- is now in CLAUDE.md beside the sibling's rule, added incrementally rather than rewritten.

Five recurring obligations read done, but the artefact they matter for is NOT stale at HEAD -- the only python/h2g/ change in six commits is the version string -- which sharpens the rule to 'expired by a later EMISSION-CHANGING commit', while the selection fix stays a grant away.
The counter-container rule is in CLAUDE.md with its four measured instances archived in docs/LESSONS.md, pinned by a new test the agent sabotaged and proved fails.

The comparability rule now sits beside KNOWN_BAD where the next candidate is chosen, naming all three outcomes with grep anchors to the scattered evidence -- and every figure is labelled historical, because the calibration artefact is still stamped v0.5.474 at 60 s.
An id prefix is a naming convention rather than a type: ^ab-N matches 6 closed ids where only 3 are real AB grants, now recorded as a rule in CLAUDE.md with the instance archived and graded.

The plan holds one task that cannot satisfy its own verify, not eight: Powerplay, whose decision tells it to write presets.json it held r: only -- now widened and re-verified, with the first 62-of-74 detector thrown away as self-measuring.

The plan had exactly one prose-only prerequisite -- ab-9's GATE on the regrid id, which now has a real depends_on edge -- against 22 false positives from one pasted priority sentence, and the gate turned out to be satisfied already.

No open verify promises to create something that already exists -- the one narrow hit is this task quoting the defect and the two wide hits are 'which this task only READS' matched across an unrelated clause, so the family is settled with nothing written.
The closure that broke is now a module-level pack_into and three tests cover it -- one calling the REAL pack_sid -- and sabotaging its mkdir reproduces the original FileNotFoundError exactly.

No uniform clock ratio hides in either low-melody row: Commodore_64_Music_Examples paces at a perfect 1.000 once paired correctly and Dragons_Lair_Part_II's is a loose 0.937 behind a subtune remap, so both stay harness artefacts on stronger evidence.
Retracted a false claim in docs/LESSONS.md: all eight probed fidelity-json keys exist under aliases rather than being absent, re-verified against the artefact.

The forever-loop passage in docs/LESSONS.md is now graded HISTORY at v0.5.375 with the current v0.5.476 reading beside it (+0.14 s, 291 attacks against 291); one cited source path was fabricated and is corrected here.

The title's claim is refuted by the code -- voices_end_together has existed since v0.5.433 and is tested -- and the real defect was legalise_restarts' docstring asserting its own absence four lines above the call, now retracted with the Confuzion rows-versus-writes distinction recorded beside it.

Whole-corpus ablation (89 files x 2 arms, -t 180), arm A validated against build/fidelity.json on 89/89 output_shas and adsr values. cut_release reaches only 31 of 89 files (58 byte-identical); it is gated on det.envelope_cut plus a per-record EFFECT_PER_FRAME check. On those 31 it costs adsr on 30 and helps it on ZERO, while helping rel (release_tail_agreement) on 29 and hurting it on zero -- release_tail_ours_longer goes to 0 on all 31. So the verify's expected split is not two disjoint file populations but one population and two opposed columns: the option zeroes the release nibble in the instrument record, which adsr charges for every sounding frame of the note in order to buy the release tail that rel scores. The second sub-mechanism (original at $0000, we hold the record) is bit-identical on both arms of all 31 files and is the entire remaining ceiling on Geoff Capes. Three of the lowest-adsr files are inert under the ablation, so their deficit has a different cause. Nothing was adopted, removed or committed; seven follow-ups proposed.

The rule is in CLAUDE.md beside its two siblings with the instance archived in docs/LESSONS.md -- and the agent corrected my miscount, since grep -c counts lines while the same file reads 3, 5 or 0 depending on the method.

Kings of the Beach (ingame) is diagnosed, not finished: its aud 0.66 is a missing pulse-width sweep (pul 3/1026, pspan 0.00x) that detection does read, with coverage, length and every sequence column already clean.

Action Biker measured and fully attributed: gate is above the corpus median so it owes nothing, the 62 drum runs are each exactly one frame short (682/744 = 11/12), and adsr 69% decomposes without remainder into a zeroed release nibble and an unreproduced note-end envelope kill.

Confuzion measured at HEAD c2cb76a (h2g 0.5.478), conversion sha 7cbac3906726 validated against the harness and the corpus row before anything was concluded. Coverage needs -t 310 (cov 1.000; -t 180 gives 0.590). All 26 columns reported with both attack counts (1022/1022, retrig 1.00 -- nothing rose by removing events). Against the 89 measured seconds=180 corpus rows, eight columns are below median and the literal and robust log-space readings agree on every one: adsr 0.2097 (med 0.8044), vib 0.7308 (0.9830), depth 1.3549 (0.8166), hold 0.0000 (0.1056), pul 1.7962x (0.9481), pphase 0.5385x (0.8750), aud 0.8513 (0.9000), loud 0.8965 (0.9503). Pace is exact -- median 1.000, IQR 1.000-1.000 over 1019 gaps, drift 0.0 frames across 8988, and the least-squares fit agrees at 1.000, so there is no fit/median divergence. --diagnose is clean, so no harness defect stands in the way. Six columns are attributed with figures: adsr to the release nibble zeroed by cut_release (A/D/S identical in all six dominant mismatch pairs); hold to 8-of-8 `fetch` at delta -1, tied to gate's 1022 surplus frames = exactly our attack count; pul to voice 0's step halving 64->32 at identical span (pspan 1.0039); pphase to voice 0 opening on 3 widths of 9 while visiting 52 against 28; vib to the per-note Goattracker vibrato command, by ablation -- removing it recovers 148 reversals (0.7308 -> 0.9624) while removing the instrument-record vibrato makes it far worse (0.042), which is the direction that proves which mechanism is the defect. depth and aud/loud are declared UNATTRIBUTED. Two refutations worth carrying forward: the vib x depth = 0.9902 compensating pair is a coincidence, not a mechanism -- depth is flat at 1.3487 while vib moves to 0.9624, so the product goes to 1.2981; and gate here is ABOVE median at 0.7656 with 1020 of 1020 releases matched, so the Zoolook mechanism is absent and the set is now seven above, one below. The `slides` option is byte-inert on this file too -- the fourth in a row. No bound declared, no option adopted, no file outside the scratch dir written.

Food_Feud at -t 180 is below the corpus median on melody/seq/pitch (attributed: one contiguous voice-0 passage, 72 of 748 attacks, played exactly -12 semitones because the version-0 track reader emits no orderlist transpose), on slides/depth (one vibrato mechanism, 1.84x the frames at 0.56x the depth), and on filt/cut (filter overshoot, both zeroed by ablating `filters`), with pphase and wave below and unattributed, gate ABOVE the median for the fifth song running, and --pace showing a median 1.000 and zero drift so timing is not a defect.

At -t 180 with the shipped presets Geoff Capes covers its whole original (cov 100%, no widening needed) and is below the 89-row corpus medians on adsr (0.1211 vs 0.8044), nrun (0.50 vs 1.00), hold (0.00 vs 0.1056), vib and depth in log space, and marginally on noise, retrig and len -- adsr is attributed by ablation to `--cut-release` (0.1211 -> 0.8147), hold/nrun/noise to one `fetch` -1, vib/depth to one vibrato-rate mechanism (0.7425 x 1.3524 = 1.0042), retrig and len left unattributed, with the pace median 1.000 (IQR 1.000-1.000, fit 0.949 diverging) and zero drift ruling out the clock.

Kings of the Beach fully attributed: the only real defect is a duty cycle frozen at 3.1% because the traced subtune's single instrument has a set-only pulse program, while wave and hold turn out to be a silent-park tail and a one-instrument slot artefact rather than defects.

Knucklebusters measured at -t 196, the minimum full-coverage window, and the window itself changes the verdict: loud reads above median there and below at -t 200, because our conversion ends 4.16 s early and a wider window charges it for the gap.

Measured Saboteur_II.sid at 665939c/v0.5.476 against corpus medians derived from the 89 measured, seconds=180 rows of build/fidelity.json. window_coverage 1.0 needs -t 260 (the original ends at 249.18 s); -t 180 reads 0.7224, and both windows are reported with every column and both attack counts (2566/2564 and 3622/3622). --diagnose is clean: identity subtune correspondence, all three voices ratio 1.00 and pitches 100%. --pace medians 1.000 (IQR 0.909-1.100 over 2963 gaps) with drift +0.00 frames/1000 across 12458 frames; the least-squares fit 0.999 agrees with the median, so there is no divergence to read, and --pace declines the file on its own 30% matched-note threshold. Below the corpus median under both log-space readings: bend 0.71x, depth 0.52x, pphase 0.67x, filt 1.70x, cut 1.50x, wave 87%, loud 93%. Attributed by ablation: filt, cut and ~64% of loud to the `filters` emitter's routing duty -- we hold the filter in circuit 11520 of 12550 frames where the player routes it in on 6400, and sweep a band 1.66x too wide; bend, depth and the slides surplus to one mechanism, the `vibrato` emitter's step size (right rate, right prevalence, half the swing); wave to a one-frame-late waveform on voices 1 and 2 (not wave_program, which is carrying the column, and not the gate, which accounts for 12% of the deficit); pphase to voice 0's note-opening duty width, which survives pulse=False. len and loud's 0.0751 residual are stated as unattributed. Three refutations recorded: gate reads ABOVE the median for the sixth file running; the staged 'no legato' note's 8046-vs-1631 does not reproduce (10667 vs 9682, the deficit 933 ties confined to voice 0); and the preset's `slides` and `vibrato_command` flags are both byte-inert here. No bound declared, no preset adopted, no converter file touched -- six follow-up ids proposed instead.

Samantha Fox measured and attributed: gate turns out to be ABOVE the corpus median so the brief was wrong again, and adsr 0.48 decomposes without remainder into an unreproduced note-end envelope kill, a zeroed release nibble and one envelope record we never emit.

Sanxion measured at -t 340 for full coverage, and the window mattered: gate was 30% artefact, pspan inverts, and two unnamed columns are worse than the named one -- with the wave deficit attributed to one firstwave frame per attack plus a fragmented drum.

Sigma Seven measured and attributed, refuting its own brief: it is below median on four fraction columns rather than one, and every note's frequency lands one frame after its gate-on -- a defect on 100% of notes that costs a single point of pitch and nothing else.

Zoolook.sid measured at -t 260 (the window at which window_coverage reaches 1.0; the tune ends at 259.22s) and at -t 180 for comparability with build/fidelity.json's 89 measured rows. My -t 180 arm reproduced the stored corpus row scalar for scalar and byte for byte (output_sha b09ced6e548b), so both arms are trustworthy. Melody, seq, pitch, adsr, onset, tail, nrun and drift are all perfect; retrig is 1.00 with identical attack counts on both sides, so nothing here rose by losing events. Derived from the corpus rather than taken from the brief, the genuinely low columns are gate, slides, depth, wave and loud - and aud, by 0.0011, which is inside its own documented noise floor and is not a finding. The headline refutes the six-song orientation: gate reads 0.3758 against a corpus median of 0.6270, the first of the seven songs to come in below it. It is attributed by ablation to the hard-restart gatetimer: every gate-off stretch the conversion has is a constant 2.3317 frames (7 calls at -S3, predicted 2.3333, gatetimer 7 in all 29 instruments) regardless of whether the player rests 8 frames or 1069, and turning max_hard_restart off moves gate 0.3995 to 0.2410 and that stretch to 1.2069 frames while leaving every other column identical to four decimals. slides, bend and depth all trace by ablation to one emitter, the classic instrument vibrato - the --slides option is byte-inert on this file, exactly as the brief warned - with depth's shortfall two-thirds explained by two named arithmetic terms (0.656 predicted against 0.561 measured) and the remaining factor declared unattributed. wave and loud are declared unattributed. --pace shows this file is on time: median 1.000 with zero integrated drift over 12960 frames, and the least-squares fit agrees with the median here. Six follow-up ids opened. No column declared a bound, no preset adopted, no converter file touched.

Both frame-axis outcomes now sit together in the naming_split docstring, labelled HISTORICAL at 7bcd3fe with HEAD's distance and what to re-run -- and the same figure in a printed report string was past-tensed and labelled too.

The --pace contradiction is settled against CLAUDE.md: the tool derives every printed figure from the median, the square-weighted fit reads 0.360 on Tarzan where the drift is zero, and the wrong instruction has been removed from CLAUDE.md, the archive and all twelve queued measure tasks.

plan_audit gains check_g, which classifies rather than counts -- 17 naive vocabulary hits over the population it considers, 0 after four structural exemptions including one the verify never named -- with its suite now committed beside the module and re-sabotaged from there.

_preset_opts now warns instead of silently returning the always block for a name absent from a populated songs list -- warn rather than raise because listen.py's --diff path legitimately takes that route, and the 32 warnings it raises are exactly the 6 corpus files with no entry.
The pulse split-leg census covers all 24 triangle-pulse files against the 255-row budget and names the overflow: Crazy_Comets needs 319 rows and fails at instrument 17.

The version-pinned artefact regeneration is replaced by a version-less recurring obligation whose done-condition is test_output_sha reading 0 disagreeing, and which says in its own verify that it cannot be closed.

All 89 staged tunes now render at one 180 s window with 0 stale and a listening note each -- the set that needed staging was 34 rather than the title's 23, and the new merge kept the 55 notes an overwrite would have destroyed.
All 89 staged tunes are now the conversion their measurement describes -- 0 stale, verified by sha -- but the set is 66 at 180 s and 23 at 120 s, so the uniform-window half is unmet and named.

All 4 decided tasks and all 7 decision records check out -- the 2 mode-flipped ones describe the work and the 2 interview-worded ones are still genuinely awaiting a human -- and a widened scan over all 106 tasks found 16 matches with 0 real defects behind them.

convert_at now returns Converted(sng, sid) and approvals stops rebuilding the .sng path by hand, with the old wording retracted where a grep lands -- but sabotaging convert_at's own return is invisible to the suite, because every test injects a fake, and that gap is opened rather than hidden.
Corrected the stale 'exercised by hand' docstring in test_sound_calibrate.py to say render_doc is now pinned; verified by my own diff inspection and suite run, not the agent's thin record.
No per-function coverage census exists to fix, so the nesting of survey.py's _ptrs was written down at its definition site instead; suites green.

The gatetimer floor is now pinned by a test sweeping the whole parameter space, and three named mutations each kill it -- one of them revealing the row_calls guard protects against a negative value, not just zero.

Nothing deleted and nothing owed here: the 13 prose entries are really 8, since five carry an id behind a dot, a capital, a parenthesis or a dash that the first-colon rule cannot see -- and the tail is stable while the log grows, so it needs no guard.

python/artefact_freshness.py works and its 13 tests and three sabotages stand, but its first real use produced a false positive -- STALE for a docstring-only emitter edit the Commando fixture proves moved no byte -- so its answer is a conservative upper bound and should say so.
The either/or-record template is used 35 times and 30 uses were already fine -- the defect was 5 missing grants, now homed, with 0 remaining and the parallel lane down one as the price.

The sound_run_ prefix is documented rather than renamed, because it is a key in build/fidelity.json -- and the agent's own note made its central measurement self-refuting, which is the retraction-collision rule generalised to documentation.

The opened backlog now has a home: docs/BACKLOG.md, 416 derived entries with 88 rationales, carrying its own generator in the header -- and a header figure that conflated two counting rules was caught and corrected before it shipped.

The three files do NOT abort under preset options -- the probe that said so passed a bare stem where presets.json keys songs with the .sid extension, so _preset_opts silently returned the always block and dropped prune, dedup and W_A_R's max_rows 128.

Chicken_Song's two 180 s readings never disagreed: onset 0.6923 and 0.8077 are the exact and graded onset columns from one record, and wave_agreement is not a key at all, so the doc's guess is retracted.

The vib/depth coupling is REFUTED on three later files -- products 1.0042, 0.689 and 0.9902-to-1.2981 under ablation, where depth moves 0.0062 against vib's 0.2316 -- so the 1.0 products are coincidences of two independently-wrong columns, closed on the run log without dispatching an agent.
